notes: Car 4c — the media face: local speech-to-text, a console voice session with a fuzzy wake matcher, inbound Telegram voice notes, BYOK image generation with photo delivery, dual-engine TTS, and read-only connectors. (1) Speech-to-text runs fully local on faster-whisper with three cached model sizes (media.stt_model tiny/base/small, default base): the module ships its own decode chain (av.open on a BytesIO -> AudioResampler to 16 kHz mono float32 -> transcribe the ndarray) because the library helper is incompatible with the installed av major version; mp3, ogg/opus and webm/opus inputs were all verified end-to-end. POST /api/stt accepts raw audio (independent 2 MB body budget, 60s decoded cap, 30/min sliding window, same loopback origin guard as /api/say, no bearer) and answers {text, language, duration} with honest 413/415/422/503/429 failures. The console Chat view gained a voice session: MediaRecorder records self-contained 2.5 s cycles, each cycle is transcribed, and the wake matcher fires on settings.media.wake_phrases — exact match first, then a bounded-edit-distance fuzzy pass over the space-stripped forms, because real ASR renders the default phrases as "Hey A-Dog" / homophone variants and an exact-only matcher never fired (a regression check now proves the shipped defaults hit the real transcript). After a wake the session captures the command for up to 10 s or until an empty segment, fills the chat input, runs the turn, and speaks the reply through the existing edge-tts chain (200 chars). Inbound Telegram voice/audio notes follow getFile -> size checks (60s / 5 MB, pre-reject before download) -> transcription -> the exact text pipeline (commands included, forum-topic session keys preserved) -> a text reply; failures answer the three new locale keys and never kill the poll loop. (2) Image generation is a BYOK OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations client with the config chain env AIDOG_IMAGE_URL > settings media.image_base_url > mycore.base_url, optional media.image_model, key slots IMAGE_API_KEY falling back to MODEL_API_KEY (loopback endpoints need no key), and b64_json/url response tolerance. It powers three surfaces: the generate_image tool (always registered; unconfigured call -> honest ERROR), a console trial panel (prompt -> thumbnail grid, honest 503 reason when unconfigured, served from data/images/ through a whitelist + parent-check path), and TG photo delivery: successful generations queue in a process-local outbox that the service drains after the text reply (caption = prompt, capped 1000 chars; a photo failure never harms the text; dry-run logs only) while the panel drains its own queue so previews never leak into a later TG turn. New TgClient getFile/download_file/send_photo carry injectable byte and multipart transports with the standing token discipline (method + exception type only). (3) TTS stays dual-engine: edge-tts remains the default and media.tts_engine=byok routes /api/say through /v1/audio/speech with honest 503 on failure — never a silent fallback — while paid engines remain documented as not-applicable under the free rule in docs/features/tts_engines.md. (4) Connectors: connector_search queries Linear (issueSearch over GraphQL with the raw personal key in Authorization — no Bearer, verified against the official SDK — unless AIDOG_LINEAR_URL overrides) and Notion (POST /v1/search, Bearer + Notion-Version 2025-09-03, AIDOG_NOTION_URL override), read-only only; the tool registers only when a LINEAR/NOTION slot exists and the registry carries an honest connector_note otherwise, capabilities reports presence booleans and never a value. Verified before these notes: the offline suite grew to 959/959 (+119 checks covering stt/imagegen/connectors/tool registration/tg media/service voice+photo legs), console smoke to 142/142 (+19), and the new E2E script ran 27 checks to completion twice — real edge-tts speech transcribed back through /api/stt with keyword assertions, the 61s refusal, default-phrase fuzzy hit against the real ASR transcript plus a negative control, mocked image/speech/Linear/Notion endpoints over real HTTP, settings and secrets snapshots restored byte-for-byte with smoke green after every restore, and a real headless-browser MediaRecorder chain (fake microphone, wake hit, HTTP transcription of the recorded webm). Locale packs grew to 277 keys (en/zh) and handover/site/competitive figures were re-synced to the new counts (26 modules, ~8.0k LOC).
